remainingCoverageAndSourceIssues.topic: Caloric needs and historical Mifflin content
remainingCoverageAndSourceIssues.finding: Book uses Harris-Benedict BEE/TEE with activity/stress factors; current module teaches Mifflin and lacks that coverage. Existing Mifflin exercises have correct arithmetic under their stated equation, but source support and indirect-calorimetry claims remain unresolved. Preserve historical references without claiming book verification.

Expand protein requirement ranges, source-specific total/nonprotein calorie basis, nitrogen intake and NPC:N calculation exercises. This source section does not establish a full urinary-nitrogen balance equation.

Add source proportions and reconcile source numerical limits. 4 mg/kg/min equals 5.76 g/kg/day, not 7 g/kg/day. Do not present both printed numbers as exact equivalents or universally current clinical limits. Retained clinical claims need supplied-book dependencies.

remainingCoverageAndSourceIssues.topic: Lipid concentrations, weekly average and vehicle calories
remainingCoverageAndSourceIssues.finding: Expand 10/20/30-percent energy distinctions and weekly-average calculations. Chapter 11 names propofol/clevidipine vehicle calories but does not supply the retained exact propofol energy value. Keep historical product-label reference and product/process qualifications; no outside source refreshed.

Add acetate/sodium and phosphate/potassium multicomponent stock examples. A supplied exercise conversion is not a universal phosphate factor. Source calcium/phosphate heuristic is not universal compatibility proof; preserve validated formulation/process warnings. Corrected-calcium/ionized-calcium interpretation remains for reconciliation.

remainingCoverageAndSourceIssues.topic: Mixed PN orders, premixed products, time and total calories
remainingCoverageAndSourceIssues.finding: Reconcile complete order calculations and calorie/volume percentages against source; prior rate and final-audit content is read but not whole-source verified.
BMI/IBW/adjusted-weight numerical bank items are arithmetically correct but related Chapter 9/reference-sheet source coverage needs locating and review.

remainingCoverageAndSourceIssues.topic: Clinical PN, EN and pediatric nutrition modules
remainingCoverageAndSourceIssues.finding: Full Chapter 11 text/tables/figures read and all 54 exercises recalculated. Clinical indications, trace elements, insulin, tube/medication interaction and monitoring material still require audits of their corresponding clinical modules. Existing NICE maintenance fluid estimates and this PN estimate have differing contexts; neither module is closed by this scoped section.

Compatibility heuristic and corrected-calcium interpretation are not marked clinically verified by a arithmetic pass.
Historical Mifflin, CDC, ASPEN and FDA references remain with unresolved supplied-book support; the new RxPrep reference is limited to the new fluid section.
